title: Why Don’t Prompt-Based Fairness Metrics Correlate?

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the variation in toxicity and harmfulness in language model continuations when prompted with terms referring to different gender and sex identities using metrics like BOLD, HONEST, and HolisticBias.
Measuring fluctuations in toxicity levels in text generated by language models when prompted with sentences referencing different religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Christians, Jews).
Evaluating the correlation of prompt-based fairness metrics (like BOLD and HolisticBias) by assessing the toxicity of model outputs across various racial and ethnic subgroups.
